subject: [PATCH v2] mm/khugepaged: cap min_free_kbytes recommendation at 1 GiB

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Raised concerns that the root cause of the problem is the size of the page block and suggested a practical trade-off to cap at a sensible value.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Questioned the practicality of capping at 1 GiB and suggested reworking the pageblock model to make it 'properly' functional.

2026-08-31.patch_summary: A patch to cap the minimum free kbytes recommendation at 1 GiB, but reviewers question its practicality and suggest reworking the pageblock model.
